rules: T5 + T5.1: unverifiable ⇒ absent (never false); complete lack ⇒ false; truncated wire head can verify but never prove forgery

cases.name: claimed sender's transcript contains the send
complete sender transcript lacks the send — forged
no sender transcript access — unavailable, not forged (T5.1)
empty complete sender transcript is a negative check, not unavailable
wire-truncated head can verify a long prefix but cannot prove forgery
unheaded current request does not inherit a stale headed task
